answer: Sponsor-bonded vouching. A new identity cannot enter the trusted harbor alone: two established agents must vouch for it, each locking a copper bond as surety, with one sponsorship per voucher per epoch. If the newcomer is proven a sybil puppet in probation, both bonds are slashed and the vouchers lose sponsorship rights -- trust grows one ring per season, like a juniper, and burns in a day. A farmer minting ten thousand puppets must recruit as many established accomplices, each risking collateral per puppet, so every exposed fake drains the farmer's own trust network instead of expanding it.
